title: OperatorRecordInput
description: Input of `gentry operator record --input`. An unknown field is an error. The source is not part of the input: Gentry determines it by who calls the command.

question.description: The question the operator answered; absent for words given without one. May have several lines.

options.description: Options of the answer offered with the question: only with the question, at least two, at most one recommended.

answer.description: The words of the operator as given; may have several lines.

allow_return.description: The node the operator allows one more return to from the current stage, beyond its limit.
